label: Smartphone

questions.why: Poor or mismatched chargers are a common cause of battery and port damage.

questions.text: Is the phone usually charged overnight or in a hot place?
questions.why: Heat and constant full charge age the battery faster.

answers.label: In a hot place, like a car or in the sun

questions.text: Does the phone have a case and a screen guard?
questions.why: They take the knocks that crack screens.

questions.text: Has the phone been dropped hard in the last few months?
questions.why: Drops can damage the screen and inner parts even without visible cracks.

questions.text: Has the phone been near water, rain or a spill?
questions.why: Water damage is usually not covered.
Updates fix bugs and security problems.

questions.text: Have you noticed the battery swelling, the phone getting very hot or draining fast?
questions.why: Early signs let you get it checked before a small fault grows.

care_tips.text: Stop using the phone and keep it away from anything that can burn if the battery swells, gets very hot or smells unusual.
care_tips.why: A damaged battery can catch fire.

care_tips.text: Don't open, puncture or crush the battery, and don't use it after a hard fall that dented it.
care_tips.why: Damaged battery cells can overheat or catch fire.

care_tips.text: Switch the phone off and unplug the charger before cleaning it.
care_tips.why: Cleaning a charging device risks a short circuit.

care_tips.text: Charge with the charger it came with or another certified one.
care_tips.why: Poor chargers can damage the battery and the charging port.

care_tips.text: Avoid charging or leaving the phone in hot places such as a car or in direct sun.
Use a case and a screen guard.
care_tips.why: They protect against the drops that crack screens.

care_tips.text: Keep the phone away from water; if it gets wet, switch it off and contact the brand's service.
care_tips.why: Water damage is usually not covered and spreads if the phone stays on.
Updates fix bugs and security problems.

care_tips.text: If the battery drains fast or the phone runs very hot, contact the brand's service.
care_tips.why: These can be signs of a battery problem.

reminders.text: Back up your phone's photos and contacts.
reminders.note: Check your manual or phone settings for automatic backup.
